content.title: Masters Week on ESPN: 140 hours of comprehensive live coverage across ESPN platforms
content.text: Coverage of the Masters begins Monday, April 6, all available on the ESPN App Live main telecasts of First and Second Rounds begin Thursday, April 9, at 3 p.m. ET on ESPN, ESPN Deportes Exclusive, live coverage of Masters Par 3 Contest on Wednesday, April 8, at noon on ESPN App, Disney+, including on-course reporting from ESPN NFL analyst Jason Kelce Four days of live Featured Groups coverage, plus Holes 4, 5 & 6; Amen Corner; Holes 15 & 16 on ESPN App Live studio shows on-site: special SportsCenter at the Masters preview show, Welcome to the Masters, Tuesday at the Masters, Wednesday at the Masters and more ESPN will present more than 140 hours of live coverage throughout Masters Week at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Ga., including live telecasts of the First and Second Rounds of the Masters Tournament on ESPN and live streams of Featured Groups and Featured Holes during all four days of competition. All available to ESPN subscribers on the ESPN App for mobile and connected TV devices. The 90th edition of the Masters Tournament marks ESPN’s 19th year of live coverage of the world’s top players at Augusta National Golf Club, providing fans with multiple viewing options and comprehensive analysis and insights on a scale worthy of the iconic event. Live studio shows on-site will include special editions of SportsCenter at the Masters, Welcome to the Masters and more, with features, player interviews and special guests, as well as live look-ins and in-progress highlights of practice rounds and Masters Tournament play. Monday & Tuesday — ESPN’s coverage of Masters Week will start with live SportsCenter segments on Monday hosted by SportsCenter anchors Michael Eaves and Matt Barrie, analysis from Curtis Strange and Andy North, and reporting from Marty Smith and Jeff Darlington. Live coverage on Tuesday, April 7, will begin at noon ET, with a two-hour Tuesday at the Masters on the ESPN App, hosted by Eaves with Strange and North, and Smith and Darlington reporting. Wednesday — Starting on the ESPN App at 10 a.m., Barrie will host Wednesday at the Masters with Strange, North and David Duval as analysts, and reporting from Smith and Darlington. Coverage of the beloved Masters Par 3 Contest begins Wednesday at noon, with two exclusive hours on the ESPN App and Disney+, followed by two additional hours on ESPN at 2 p.m., hosted by SportsCenter anchor Scott Van Pelt with Smith and ESPN NFL analyst Jason Kelce conducting interviews with players and their families. Laura Rutledge will host Welcome to the Masters on ESPN at 1 p.m., and a special SportsCenter at the Masters preview show on ESPN will start at 4 p.m., led by Eaves, with North and Duval, as well as Smith and Darlington. A primetime encore presentation of the Masters Par 3 Contest will air on ESPN2 at 10 p.m., and will be available on-demand on the ESPN App and Disney+. Thursday & Friday — Live coverage of the First and Second Rounds of the Masters Tournament on the ESPN App will start Thursday morning at 8:45 a.m., with a Featured Holes feed showcasing Augusta’s Nos. 4, 5 and 6, and Featured Groups at 9:15 a.m. Coverage of Augusta’s hallowed Amen Corner begins at 10:45 a.m., with another Featured Holes stream capturing Nos. 15 and 16 starting at noon. The live telecasts on Thursday and Friday on ESPN will begin with a two-hour Welcome to the Masters hosted by Rutledge at 10 a.m., and special editions of SportsCenter at the Masters with dedicated coverage will follow with Barrie hosting at noon, 1 and 2 p.m. Live coverage of Masters Tournament play from 3 to 7:30 p.m., on ESPN will be hosted by Van Pelt, along with analysis from Strange and Eaves conducting post-round interviews. Prime time encore presentations of the First and Second Rounds will air on ESPN starting at 8 p.m., on Thursday and Friday nights, respectively, with second encores during overnight hours on ESPN2 from 3 to 6 a.m. Saturday & Sunday — Third and Final Round coverage of the Masters Tournament on Saturday and Sunday will start with a Featured Groups stream on the ESPN App at 10:15 a.m., and Featured Holes (Nos. 4, 5 and 6) at 10:30 a.m. An Amen Corner feed begins at 11:45 a.m., with Featured Holes (Nos. 15 and 16) at 12:30 p.m. Masters Week on ESPN — Augusta National Golf Club, Augusta, Ga. Additional Masters Week coverage across ESPN platforms: The Masters on-demand on the ESPN App includes a collection of 52 official Masters Films from past Tournaments going back to Gary Player’s second Masters title in 1974 through last year’s dramatic playoff win by Rory McIlroy to complete his career Grand Slam, in addition to highlight videos, a replay of the Masters Par 3 Contest and more. The Masters on ESPN.com will include exclusive news, columns and analysis from ESPN.com writers before, during and after the Masters Tournament. ESPN reporters Mark Schlabach, Paolo Uggetti, Dave Wilson and Dan Wetzel will be on location in Augusta, Ga. The Masters on ESPN’s daily studio shows will feature ESPN golf analysts and reporters appearing across ESPN’s most popular programs throughout the week, including Get Up!, First Take, The Pat McAfee Show, PTI and others. The Masters on ESPN Audio will include live interviews from Augusta, Ga., with ESPN’s golf analysts and reporters on ESPN Radio programs during Masters Week. The Masters on ESPN Deportes will air live Spanish language coverage of the First and Second Rounds from 3 to 7:30 p.m., in addition to live Third and Final Round coverage from 5 to 7 p.m. Hernán Rey and Matias Anselmo will call the play with John Sutcliffe reporting from the course. The Masters on international ESPN platforms includes live Spanish and Portuguese language telecasts of all rounds of the Masters Tournament and the Masters Par 3 Contest on ESPN’s networks in Latin America, as well as the Caribbean in English language. ESPN will also present live streams of Masters on the Range, Featured Groups, Amen Corner, Holes 4, 5 and 6, and Holes 15 and 16 available on Disney+. In Canada, TSN and RDS will air the Masters Par 3 Contest and live coverage of all four rounds of the Masters Tournament. Featured Groups, Amen Corner, Holes 4, 5 and 6, and Holes 15 and 16 will stream live on TSN+. RDS will provide coverage of all Masters rounds in French language. ESPN’s Georgia on My Mind marketing campaign for the seventh consecutive year includes a cover of the song made famous by the legendary Ray Charles, which has become synonymous with the tradition-rich Tournament. This year’s rendition was recorded by Georgia-born country music artist Thomas Rhett and is available on multiple music platforms. ESPN’s marketing spot for the Masters with Rhett can be viewed on YouTube, along with a behind-the-scenes look at Rhett’s recording session of the song. Image courtesy Augusta National Golf Club. ### All of ESPN. All in One Place. ESPN offers its full suite of networks and services directly to fans on the ESPN App with an ESPN Unlimited subscription, providing more choice, flexibility and access to all of ESPN, including more than 47,000 live events per year, on-demand replays, industry-leading studio shows and original programming, and more. The ESPN App gives fans a unique viewing experience that includes multiview and synchronized two-screen viewing options, swipe-able shortform vertical video and a personalized SportsCenter For You, as well as integrated game stats, ESPN Fantasy sports, betting odds and information from DraftKings, sports merchandise, and more. These features are available to all fans who watch on the ESPN App on mobile and connected TV devices, whether they subscribe directly or through a pay TV package from certain providers. Bundling options available for fans include a Disney+, Hulu, ESPN offering that provides a one-of-a-kind streaming package combining sports with branded and general entertainment. For more visit stream.espn.com.
